name: OBS
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: Workflow actions that control OBS: switch the program scene, show or hide a source, mute or unmute an audio input, and load a web page in a browser source. The engine holds the OBS WebSocket connection; this module reaches it through ctx.obs.

settings.label: OBS address
settings.description: The computer running OBS. The WoofX3 companion fills this in when OBS runs on your PC.

settings.label: WebSocket port
settings.description: The Server Port in OBS under Tools → WebSocket Server Settings (4455 unless you changed it).

settings.label: WebSocket password
settings.description: The Server Password in OBS under Tools → WebSocket Server Settings. Leave it empty if authentication is turned off.

actions.name: Switch OBS scene
actions.description: Make a scene the live program scene in OBS. The step fails, with the reason, when OBS is not connected or has no scene by that name.

schema.label: Scene
schema.description: The scene's name exactly as OBS shows it.

fields.description: True once OBS has applied the change. A step OBS refused fails instead, with the reason.

actions.name: Show or hide OBS source
actions.description: Show or hide a source in an OBS scene. The step fails, with the reason, when OBS is not connected or the source is not in that scene.

schema.label: Source
schema.description: The source's name exactly as OBS shows it.

schema.label: Visible
schema.description: On shows the source; off hides it.

schema.label: Scene
schema.description: The scene the source is in. Leave blank for whichever scene is live when the step runs.

fields.description: True once OBS has applied the change. A step OBS refused fails instead, with the reason.

actions.name: Mute or unmute OBS audio
actions.description: Mute or unmute an audio input in OBS, such as a microphone or desktop audio. The step fails, with the reason, when OBS is not connected or has no input by that name.

schema.label: Audio input
schema.description: The input's name exactly as OBS's audio mixer shows it.

schema.label: Muted
schema.description: On mutes the input; off unmutes it.

fields.description: True once OBS has applied the change. A step OBS refused fails instead, with the reason.

actions.name: Show a web page in OBS
actions.description: Load a web page in a browser source and show it. The source is added to the scene the first time and reused after that. The step fails, with the reason, when OBS is not connected or a source with that name is something other than a browser source.

schema.label: Web page
schema.description: The address to load, starting with https:// or http://.

schema.label: Browser source
schema.description: The browser source's name. If OBS has none by that name, one is made.

schema.label: Scene
schema.description: The scene to show it in. Leave blank for whichever scene is live when the step runs.

fields.description: True once OBS has applied the change. A step OBS refused fails instead, with the reason.
